featured_reviews.review_text: Book Trotters Club is more than a class or a community. We believed our son was not very vocal, didn't like to read fiction and was a reluctant writer. We were proven wrong after we enrolled him for these sessions with Harshikaa. Our son loves these sessions and we hope more children can join and gain from her wonderful mentoring and guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Dhara Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text: I have both my kids going to the cub for more than a year and I am amazed by their growth . They have developed a profound interest in reading different books and they can’t seem to get enough ,. Harshika Ma’am has an excellent approach towards kids and she takes special care to nurture the kids which lets the kids have their curiosity high and interest well quipped .

featured_reviews.name: Manali Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Initially my son was reluctant to read books. But after joining Book Trotters he is enjoying reading, his vocabulary has improved and he is always keen and excited to attend classes. Ms. Harshika Udasi is excellent. Writing skills has also improved.

featured_reviews.name: Sujata Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Harshikaa ma'am is a superb guide to her students. The way she engages children in her class is commendable. She develops an inherent skill for kids to develop love for reading. She also develops children's creativity by developing their writing skills by independent writing. Children eventually develops enhanced vocabulary and language skills. Thank you Harshikaa ma'am for being an excellent mentor. We love you.

featured_reviews.name: Manasi Wagle
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review from my daughter:
Joining the kids' book club with Teacher Harshika Udasi has been a highlight of my year! She doesn't just talk about books but also makes them come alive with her enthusiasm. From learning new words to understanding tricky grammar rules, she's always there to guide us. What I love most is how she encourages us to express our thoughts in essays. It's like she's unlocking a whole new world of writing for us! Each session is a mix of learning and laughter, and I grow more eager for the next class. I'm so glad I joined this club because it's not just about books; it's about enthusiastic adventures with having her as a writer herself. I hope that her online classes soon turn to offline. Can’t wait for our next meeting already :)

featured_reviews.name: Manasi Gadkari
featured_reviews.review_text: Since last one year my daughter is enjoying Harshika's reading sessions. Each batch has limited number of students and hence each child gets proper attention. These interactive reading sessions are so much fun filled that my daughter waits for her upcoming sessions. Harshika make the kids feel so comfortable that kids express their thoughts so well. It's not just a book reading class it's far more than that where your child can develop interst in reading books as well as they can connect well with the story they are reading. They share their ideas in a group and have fun. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Smita Sen Khambaswadkar
featured_reviews.review_text: A must visit for all kids. My daughter loves the way Harshikaa aunty introduces different genre of books and puts life into each story.  She makes each session of book reading very interactive and memorable. Lovely book collection at Book Trotters club for each age group
